data_description.consider_home: Keeps a device marked 'home' for this many seconds after it drops off the client list, to avoid flapping caused by Wi-Fi power save.
data_description.rssi_limit: Only applies to EasyMesh satellite stations. A weaker signal than this is treated as not home.

error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.
